profile.data.title: Your data
profile.data.help: Download everything MENT stores about you: profile, skills, experience, reflections, requests, the messages you sent and your searches. Other people's messages and private notes are not included.
profile.data.error: We could not prepare your data. Please try again.
profile.ai.title: AI suggestions
profile.ai.onHelp: On: the AI assistant can suggest you to people looking for help, read a CV you upload and tag your reflections with skills.
profile.ai.offHelp: Off: your profile, CV and reflections are never sent to the AI and you are not suggested by the assistant. People can still find you in Explorer. If you use the chat yourself, what you type and your first name are still sent to write the message.
profile.delete.title: Delete your account
profile.delete.help: Permanently deletes your profile, skills, experience, reflections, searches and the messages you sent, and closes your login. People you met keep their own side of those conversations.
profile.delete.confirmBody: This cannot be undone. Open requests and meetings are cancelled, and you will be signed out. Download your data first if you want a copy.
profile.delete.error: We could not delete your account. Please try again, or contact your school's MENT administrator.
